title: THE LIVING GOD WHO CONQUERED DEATH

memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "But the Lord is the true God; He is the living God and the everlasting King. At His wrath the earth trembles, and the nations cannot endure His indignation." — Jeremiah 10:10

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
When we say our God is "Living," we realize that He is eternal and holds all authority. A sculpture may be beautiful, but it cannot speak to us. A painting may be exquisite, but it cannot wipe away our tears. However, our Living God pays attention to our every sigh.
​By dying on the cross and rising again on the third day, Jesus Christ proved that He is the "Living God" who has conquered even death. Today, your life might feel hopeless, dark like a tomb. But when the Living God enters your life, a new life is born there.
​When we are weary, calling Him "Living God" brings a new strength within us. Only someone who is alive can give life to others. When we are in "lifeless" situations like the fear of death, failure, or disappointment, the Living God touches and lifts us up. He is unchanging and lives forever!
​The One who gave life to the bones in Ezekiel's parched valley is powerful enough to give new life to our weary souls today. When we call upon Him as "Living God," the power of heaven descends to earth.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "Our God is the only one who broke the power of death; for those who are in Him, there is no end, only eternal life."

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: My Living God, I praise You. Thank You for being alive and for being with me and my family. Breathe Your breath of life upon my dead hopes, broken relationships, and my weary soul. Deliver me from the fear of death and grant me the joy of Your eternal life. In Jesus' name I pray, Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: The world may tell you "it is over." But when the Living God is with you, nothing is ever truly over. God is going to grant a new beginning in your life. Step forward today with faith!
